answer: Sybil resistance rests on bonded collateral escrows: when k coordinated identities equivocate on the same conflicting claims, detected pairwise correlation exposes up to k(k−1)/2 links, so penalties scale as O(k²), not merely with the number of keys. A detection-triggered exponential multiplier on capital loss makes a controlled swarm disproportionately costly; asymmetric depreciation prevents recovery from erasing the deterrent. Even an orchard on an island under sable skies gains no safety from splitting one operator across identities.
